enDef: lasting for or taking only a short time

example.en: Her nails were bitten to the quick.
example.cn: 她的指甲都咬到肉里了。

cn: 轻声的， 安静的， 沉默的； 平静的， 寂静的；
enDef: not making much noise, or making no noise at all

example.en: We’ll have to be quiet so as not to wake the baby.
example.cn: 我们得安静点，免得吵醒宝宝。

enDef: a playing card with a picture of a queen on it

example.en: the queen of diamonds
example.cn: 方块Q，方块王后

cn: 问题， 议题； 疑问； 询问； 难题， 需讨论(或考
enDef: a sentence or phrase that is used to ask for information or to test someone’s knowledge

example.en: Can I ask you a question?
example.cn: 我能问你个问题吗？

cn: 相当， 颇； 实际上， 真正地； 完全， 十分
enDef: You use quite to indicate that something is the case to a fairly great extent

example.en: I felt quite bitter about it at the time.
example.cn: 当时我对此感到相当痛苦。

cn: 四分之一；地区；季度；一刻钟；两角五分；节
enDef: one of four equal parts into which something can be divided

example.en: It’s about a page and a quarter.
example.cn: 大概是一又四分之一页。

enDef: very good – used especially by people who are trying to sell something

example.en: quality childcare at prices people can afford
example.cn: 人们负担得起的优质儿童护育服务

enDef: to form or join a line of people or vehicles waiting to do something or go somewhere

example.en: File not in print queue.
example.cn: 文件不在打印队列中。

enDef:
A

quilt

is a thin cover filled with feathers or some other warm, soft material, which you put over your blankets when you are in bed.
to leave a job, school etc, especially without finishing it completely

example.en: He quit his job after an argument with a colleague.
example.cn: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

cn: 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格
enDef: if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject

example.en: He left school without any qualifications.
example.cn: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

enDef: an amount of something that can be counted or measured

example.en: Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
example.cn: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

enDef: a short test that a teacher gives to a class

example.en: a biology quiz
example.cn: 生物测验

enDef: to have an argument

example.en: I wish you two would stop quarreling.
example.cn: 我希望你们两个别再吵了。

enDef: a written set of questions which you give to a large number of people in order to collect information

example.en: Teachers will be asked to fill in a questionnaire.
example.cn: 教师们将被要求填写一份调查问卷。

enDef: if the earth, a building etc quakes, it shakes violently

example.en: The explosion made the whole house quake.
example.cn: 爆炸使整个房子都晃动起来。

enDef: to have the right to have or do something, or to give someone this right

example.en: Free school lunches are given to children who qualify.
example.cn: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

enDef: a sentence or phrase from a book, speech etc which you repeat in a speech or piece of writing because it is interesting or amusing

example.en: The following quotation is taken from a nineteenth century travel diary.
example.cn: 下文引自19世纪的一篇旅行日记。

enDef: to repeat exactly what someone else has said or written

example.en: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
example.cn: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

enDef: relating to the quality or standard of something rather than the quantity

example.en: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
example.cn: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。

cn: 奇怪的， 异常的； 不舒服的， 眩晕的
enDef: strange or difficult to explain

example.en: She gave a queer laugh.
example.cn: 她古怪地笑了笑。

enDef: to search for sth that is difficult to find

example.en: He had been questing for religious belief from an early age.
example.cn: 他从早年开始就一直在寻求宗教信仰。

enDef: to stop a fire from burning

example.en: a desperate bid to quench the raging flames
example.cn: 为扑灭熊熊大火而不顾一切的努力

enDef: Something that is quantifiable can be measured or counted in a scientific way

example.en: A clearly quantifiable measure of quality is not necessary.
example.cn: 一种确切的可计量的质量检测是不必要的。

enDef: to become quicker or make something quicker

example.en: Ray glanced at his watch and quickened his pace (= began to walk faster ).
example.cn: 雷瞥了一眼手表，加快了步伐。

enDef: an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period

example.en: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
example.cn: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

enDef: a hard mineral substance that is used in making electronic watches and clocks

example.en: quartz crystals
example.cn: 石英晶体

enDef: to calculate the value of something and express it as a number or an amount

example.en: an attempt to quantify the region’s social and economic decline
example.cn: 对该地区社会和经济衰退进行量化的尝试

enDef: relating to amounts rather than to the quality or standard of something

example.en: We need to do a proper quantitative analysis of this problem.
example.cn: 我们需要对这个问题作一个正确的定量分析。

enDef: not likely to be true or correct

example.en: The statistics are highly questionable.
example.cn: 这个统计数据大有问题。

enDef: produced or happening four times a year

example.en: We publish a quarterly journal.
example.cn: 我们出版一份季刊。

enDef: to shake slightly because you are cold, or because you feel very afraid, angry, excited etc

example.en: The child was quivering in her arms.
example.cn: 那孩子在她怀里发抖。

enDef: a unit for measuring liquid, equal to two pints. In Britain this is 1.14 litres, and in the US it is 0.95 litres.

example.en: The guardian found a quarterly quart of quartz in the safeguard.
example.cn: 监护人在安全装置内找到了四分之一夸脱石英。

enDef: unusual and attractive, especially in an old-fashioned way

example.en: a quaint little village in Yorkshire
example.cn: 约克郡一个古色古香的小村庄

enDef: a place where large amounts of stone or sand are dug out of the ground

example.en: a slate quarry
example.cn: 板岩采石场
